# infoblox_ipv6_range (Resource)

Manages an Infoblox Ipv6range in both NIOS and UDDI backends.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// Create an IPv6 Network that contains the ranges (Required as Parent)
resource "infoblox_ipv6_network" "example" {
  nios = {
    network = "15::/64"
  }
}

// Create DHCP IPv6 Range with Address Type set to "ADDRESS" (default)
resource "infoblox_ipv6_range" "create_ipv6range_with_default_address_type" {
  nios = {
    network      = infoblox_ipv6_network.example.nios.network
    start_addr   = "15::10"
    end_addr     = "15::20"
    address_type = "ADDRESS"
  }
}

// Create DHCP IPv6 Range with Address Type set to "PREFIX"
resource "infoblox_ipv6_range" "create_ipv6range_with_address_type_prefix" {
  nios = {
    network           = infoblox_ipv6_network.example.nios.network
    ipv6_start_prefix = "15:0:0:1000::"
    ipv6_end_prefix   = "15:0:0:1fff::"
    ipv6_prefix_bits  = 80
    address_type      = "PREFIX"
  }
}

// Create DHCP IPv6 Range with Address Type set to "BOTH"
resource "infoblox_ipv6_range" "create_ipv6range_with_address_type_both" {
  nios = {
    network           = infoblox_ipv6_network.example.nios.network
    start_addr        = "15::25"
    end_addr          = "15::35"
    ipv6_start_prefix = "15:0:0:2000::"
    ipv6_end_prefix   = "15:0:0:2fff::"
    ipv6_prefix_bits  = 80
    address_type      = "BOTH"
  }
}

// Create DHCP IPv6 Range with Additional Fields
resource "infoblox_ipv6_range" "create_ipv6range_with_additional_fields" {
  nios = {
    network    = infoblox_ipv6_network.example.nios.network
    start_addr = "15::40"
    end_addr   = "15::50"

    // Additional Fields
    comment = "DHCP IPv6 Range created by Terraform"
    ext_attrs = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
    exclude = [{
      start_address = "15::40",
      end_address   = "15::45",
      comment       = "Exclude range 15::40 - 15::45",
    }]
  }
}
```

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// Create an IP Space (Required as Parent)
resource "infoblox_network_view" "example" {
  uddi = {
    name    = "example"
    comment = "Example IP space created by the terraform provider"
    tags = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}

// Create an IPv6 Network that contains the range (Required as Parent)
resource "infoblox_ipv6_network" "example" {
  uddi = {
    address = "2001:db8:1::"
    cidr    = 64
    space   = infoblox_network_view.example.id
  }
}

// Create an IPv6 Range
resource "infoblox_ipv6_range" "example" {
  uddi = {
    start = "2001:db8:1::15"
    end   = "2001:db8:1::30"
    space = infoblox_network_view.example.id

    // Other optional fields
    name    = "example"
    comment = "Example IPv6 Range created by the terraform provider"
    tags = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
    exclusion_ranges = [
      {
        start = "2001:db8:1::17"
        end   = "2001:db8:1::20"
      }
    ]
  }
  depends_on = [infoblox_ipv6_network.example]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `nios` (Attributes) NIOS backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios))
- `uddi` (Attributes) UDDI backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--uddi))
- `update_trigger` (String) An arbitrary value used to trigger an update. Not sent to the API. Change it when Terraform reports no infrastructure changes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The reference to the object.

<a id="nestedatt--nios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nios`

Required:

- `network` (String) The network this range belongs to, in IPv6 Address/CIDR format.

Optional:

- `address_type` (String) Type of a DHCP IPv6 Range object. Valid values are "ADDRESS", "PREFIX", or "BOTH". When the address type is "ADDRESS", values for the 'start_addr' and 'end_addr' members are required. When the address type is "PREFIX", values for 'ipv6_start_prefix', 'ipv6_end_prefix', and 'ipv6_prefix_bits' are required. When the address type is "BOTH", values for 'start_addr', 'end_addr', 'ipv6_start_prefix', 'ipv6_end_prefix', and 'ipv6_prefix_bits' are all required.
- `cloud_info` (Attributes) Structure containing all cloud API related information for this object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios--cloud_info))
- `comment` (String) Comment for the range; maximum 256 characters.
- `disable` (Boolean) Determines whether a range is disabled or not. When this is set to False, the range is enabled.
- `discovery_basic_poll_settings` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios--discovery_basic_poll_settings))
- `discovery_blackout_setting` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios--discovery_blackout_setting))
- `discovery_member` (String) The member that will run discovery for this range.
- `enable_discovery` (Boolean) Determines whether a discovery is enabled or not for this range. When this is set to False, the discovery for this range is disabled.
- `enable_immediate_discovery` (Boolean) Determines if the discovery for the range should be immediately enabled.
- `end_addr` (String) The IPv6 Address end address of the DHCP IPv6 range.
- `exclude` (Attributes List) These are ranges of IP addresses that the appliance does not use to assign to clients. You can use these exclusion addresses as static IP addresses. They contain the start and end addresses of the exclusion range, and optionally,information about this exclusion range. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios--exclude))
- `ext_attrs` (Map of String) Extensible attributes associated with the object. For valid values for extensible attributes, see {extattrs:values}.
- `ipv6_end_prefix` (String) The IPv6 Address end prefix of the DHCP IPv6 range.
- `ipv6_prefix_bits` (Number) Prefix bits of the DHCP IPv6 range.
- `ipv6_start_prefix` (String) The IPv6 Address starting prefix of the DHCP IPv6 range.
- `logic_filter_rules` (Attributes List) This field contains the logic filters to be applied to this IPv6 range. This list corresponds to the match rules that are written to the DHCPv6 configuration file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios--logic_filter_rules))
- `member` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios--member))
- `name` (String) This field contains the name of the Microsoft scope.
- `network_view` (String) The name of the network view in which this range resides.
- `option_filter_rules` (Attributes List) This field contains the Option filters to be applied to this IPv6 range. The appliance uses the matching rules of these filters to select the address range from which it assigns a lease. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios--option_filter_rules))
- `port_control_blackout_setting` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios--port_control_blackout_setting))
- `recycle_leases` (Boolean) If the field is set to True, the leases are kept in the Recycle Bin until one week after expiration. Otherwise, the leases are permanently deleted.
- `restart_if_needed` (Boolean) Restarts the member service.
- `same_port_control_discovery_blackout` (Boolean) If the field is set to True, the discovery blackout setting will be used for port control blackout setting.
- `server_association_type` (String) The type of server that is going to serve the range. Valid values are: * MEMBER * NONE
- `start_addr` (String) The IPv6 Address starting address of the DHCP IPv6 range.
- `subscribe_settings` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios--subscribe_settings))
- `template` (String) If set on creation, the range will be created according to the values specified in the named template.

Read-Only:

- `ext_attrs_all` (Map of String) All ext_attrs including Terraform Internal ID and inherited attributes.

<a id="nestedatt--uddi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `uddi`

Required:

- `end` (String) The end IP address of the range.
- `space` (String) The resource identifier.
- `start` (String) The start IP address of the range.

Optional:

- `comment` (String) The description for the range. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.

- `exclusion_ranges` (Attributes List) The list of all exclusion ranges in the scope of the range. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--uddi--exclusion_ranges))
- `filters` (Attributes List) The list of all allow/deny filters of the range. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--uddi--filters))
- `inheritance_sources` (Attributes) The inheritance configuration that specifies how the _dhcp_options_ field is inherited from the parent object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--uddi--inheritance_sources))
- `name` (String) The name of the range. May contain 1 to 256 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the range in JSON format.
- `threshold` (Attributes) A __UtilizationThreshold__ object represents IP address utilization threshold settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--uddi--threshold))

<a id="nestedatt--uddi--threshold"></a>
### Nested Schema for `uddi.threshold`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the utilization threshold for IP addresses is enabled or not.
- `high` (Number) The high threshold value for the percentage of used IP addresses relative to the total IP addresses available in the scope of the object. Thresholds are inclusive in the comparison test.
- `low` (Number) The low threshold value for the percentage of used IP addresses relative to the total IP addresses available in the scope of the object. Thresholds are inclusive in the comparison test.
